text:
deploybot: :warning: RELEASE_BLOCKED - Release 2026.03.20 (commit 6f2a9d) failed env parity validation. Mismatch found: feature flag default 'enable_new_router' = true in staging, false in prod. Runbook checklist step 'normalize-flag-defaults' returned NON-COMPLIANT.

maria: ugh, saw this when I kicked the canary. Deploybot blocked the rollout automatically.

kevin: where did the default flip happen? not in our feature branch AFAICT.

sasha: looks like the flag was added by ops-infra a month ago with default=false, but the onboarding script in infra-scripts sets it to true for new environments.

ani: so staging has the onboarding override + a manual patch earlier. prod never got the onboarding override due to a tag filter.

maria: this is a parity issue, but it's only a flag default. can we let the release pass and patch prod after?

deploybot: Note: Allowing the release without normalizing flag defaults may cause behavioral divergence in canary traffic. Deploybot recommends either backfill prod config or pin service to previous image tag.

kevin: pinning loses the bugfix in the release. backfill sounds safer but requires a small config change with approval.

sasha: I can open a quick PR to the prod-config repo to set enable_new_router=true. will need ops-oncall approval for out-of-band change.

ops-oncall: I'm here. What's the risk? If we flip prod to true, do we expect traffic changes?

maria: behavior should match staging now; the new router is behind the flag but defaults control edge cases. We've run regression tests in staging, looks good.

ani: checklist: 1) create prod config PR 2) run config sync job locally to preview 3) approve + merge 4) re-run deploybot validation 5) continue rollout.

kevin: timeline? we have a 2-hour change window. can we get it done within that?

sasha: I'll draft PR now, pinging @ops-oncall for review.

ops-oncall: on it. quick question: is there any KMS or secret change coupled to this?

maria: no secrets. just a boolean in prod-config CM.

deploybot: Automated note: pre-merge hook will run config-sync and flag-emulation tests. If tests fail, the release will remain blocked.

ani: if for some reason we can't get approval in window, fallback plan is to pin service to image 6f2a9c (previous). That keeps behavior stable but delays the feature.

kevin: agreed. let's try backfill first. sasha, tag me in the PR and I'll review quickly.

sasha: PR created: https://git.company/prod-configs/merge/542 - sets enable_new_router: true for prod. includes automated preview output.

ops-oncall: reviewed the preview diff. looks clean. approving now.

deploybot: deploybot detected merged config change. Re-running env parity validation...

deploybot: :white_check_mark: VALIDATION_PASSED - Runbook checklist step 'normalize-flag-defaults' completed. Release unblocked. You may resume the rollout.

maria: thanks everyone. resuming rollout in 2min. will watch for errors.

kevin: tracking metrics dashboard. if anything spikes, we rollback.

ani: adding a quick postmortem note to release docs: root cause: onboarding script applied staging-only override; missing gating in infra-scripts. follow-up: add gating and an automated parity check for onboarding overrides.

sasha: filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-1427 - ensure onboarding overrides are applied consistently across envs and add CI guard.

maria: nice. closing thread after rollout completes cleanly. :thumbsup:
